content:
STAGE 1 - goal: fix the design slot before writing the proposal.
READ: the task brief only (no file reads are permitted in this session; the working directory exposes opencode.json/running.json/progress.jsonl but read is denied). Catalog search for append_progress -> found tools.progress.append_progress.
OBSERVED: the brief already refutes (a) every partition-own-geometry metric (Voronoi margin -0.081, adjacency R2 +0.156, Frechet cover radius -0.146, bucket reach lift +0.041) and (b) plain path likelihood (-0.488, rewards collapse, tops out on the 12/2/3-code tables). Only reference-contrast metrics survive; HBAA (level-1 prefix aligned to a single global training-history barycentre, contrast against the mean of 10 negatives, Gromov inner product) is the bar at +0.701, with Euclidean (+0.693) and anchor-only (+0.694) controls, i.e. the win comes from the CONTRAST not from the curvature.
REASONING: the two explicit routes to more information than HBAA are (i) the whole history as query set instead of one barycentre, and (ii) the full negative distribution as a tempered expected rank instead of a mean of 10. Both are unused together. To stay out of the refuted likelihood family (which rewards few branches) the rank must be contrasted against a size-matched null, and that null must be the exact log-prior of the cell (no tunable temperature), not a hand-made weight.
DECISION: design slot = tempered hyperbolic expected-rank of the level-1 gold cell over ALL K cells, queried by every training source (whole history as a query distribution, not one point), with cell centroids taken at the item's SOURCE-TARGET GEODESIC MIDPOINT (uses the target half of the frozen reference, which HBAA never touches), and scored as the gain over the exact cell-size-prior ranker divided by K.
STILL OPEN: exact normaliser (K vs uniform-rank (K-1)/2) - resolved in stage 2; K->N blindness must be declared as the failure mode.

STAGE 2 - goal: close the two open numerical choices and check degeneracies.
READ: nothing new; arithmetic on the candidate formulas.
OBSERVED: (a) normaliser. Dividing the per-pair rank gain by the uniform-rank constant (K-1)/2 makes a 2-code and a 256-code table both reach +1 and therefore re-imports the collapse reward that killed hyp_hsoftmax_path (its three highest values were the 12/2/3-code tables). Dividing by K instead caps a 2-code table at 0.5 and a 3-code at 0.667, so coarseness is penalised without measuring it. Chose /K. (b) bound. ER_prior and ER_geo both live in [1,K], so the gain is in [-(K-1),K-1] and M in [-1,+1]; no clipping constant is needed. (c) K=1 gives ER_prior=ER_geo=1 and M=0 automatically, matching the known "one-code table scores 0". (d) random relabelling: all centroids collapse to the global midpoint, ER_geo = (K+1)/2 while ER_prior is the exact size-prior rank, so a random table is ~0 when sizes are balanced and strongly negative when sizes are skewed (popularity-only table). Both are correct penalties. (e) K->N: with n_k=1 everywhere ER_prior=(K+1)/2 and the cell ranking equals the reference's own item ranking, so M saturates at ~0.5 for ANY such table - declared as the failure mode, not fixed, because fixing it would need a tunable constant.
STILL OPEN: none; writing the answer.

STAGE 3 - FINAL ANSWER (condensed record; the full block was printed in the response).
METRIC: hyp_midpoint_rank_gain_l1. Poincare ball, curvature -1. Each item gets a canonical point a_i = geodesic midpoint exp_{u_i}(log_{u_i}(v_i)/2) of its frozen source and target reps; each level-1 cell k gets c_k = Karcher/Frechet barycentre of its members' a_i (50 fixed iterations); tau = the reference temperature, score = -d/tau. For each training pair (i,g): ER_prior(i) = 1 + sum_{k!=k*} n_k/(n_k+n_{k*}) (the exact untempered log-prior rank of the gold cell, no tunable constant) and ER_geo(i) = 1 + sum_{k!=k*} sigma((d(u_i,c_k)-d(u_i,c_{k*}))/tau). M = mean over training pairs of (ER_prior - ER_geo)/K, M=0 if K=1. One scalar in [-1,+1], higher better.
WHAT IT ADDS over Q_H (+0.634) and HBAA (+0.701): the whole training history votes as a distribution of queries instead of one global barycentre; the negative side is the full tempered expected rank over all K cells instead of a mean over ten negatives; the centroids use the target half of the reference through the geodesic midpoint, which no measured metric touches; and the exact size prior is subtracted, so bucket collapse and popularity-only tables earn nothing.
CONSTANTS: curvature -1, midpoint fraction 1/2 (canonical), 50 Karcher sweeps, tau from the reference, normaliser K from the codebook size. Nothing tuned on the 97 recalls.
COMPUTE: 24587 exp/log midpoints, 50 Karcher sweeps, one |Tr|xK geodesic distance matrix, two logistic reductions; seconds in numpy, far under a minute.
RISK: tau large -> degenerates to a cell-size statistic; tau tiny -> noisy hard rank; needs source and target in the same ball; skewed cell sizes let rare-cell pairs dominate; coarse-but-clean 2-4 code tables reach 0.5-0.75.
FAILURE MODE: K close to N (one code per item) - centroids become the items themselves, the size prior is uniform, and M saturates at ~+0.5 for every such table, so it goes blind exactly where the level-1 prefix degenerates into an item id. Second worst: cells split by popularity, where ER_prior ~ 1 and M is driven to -1 despite coherent cells.
The complete formatted answer block was emitted verbatim in the assistant response.
